sections.contraindications: Amoxicillin is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to penicillins or beta-lactam antibiotics.
sections.drug_interactions: Probenecid decreases the renal tubular secretion of amoxicillin and may increase amoxicillin blood levels. Amoxicillin may reduce the efficacy of oral contraceptives.
sections.warnings: Serious and occasionally fatal hypersensitivity reactions have been reported with penicillins. Discontinue amoxicillin if an allergic reaction occurs.
